exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Sentence A. Sorede Sentence B".

options.text: A とか B とか
文A。それで 文B
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 文A。それで 文B matches "Sentence A. Sorede Sentence B".

exercises.explanation: Connects sentences; B is the result or consequence of A.
